docs.title: AI Gateway
docs.text:
Every open-source model. One platform. Total control.

By Infinia Technologies

docs.title: The Problem
docs.text: AI is no longer optional — every team, every product, every business unit needs it yesterday. But enterprises today are forced to juggle 5-12 different model providers just to access the open-source LLMs their teams demand. The result? Engineering organizations burn 2-4 developer-weeks per quarter on integration plumbing, vendor wrangling, and firefighting outages instead of shipping products. And beneath the chaos: zero unified governance, no cost visibility, and no compliance layer — leaving security teams flying blind, finance teams guessing at spend, and leadership unable to answer the simplest question: "What AI are we actually running?"

docs.title: Why We Win
docs.text:
• Built-in customers — 422 IHC subsidiaries, near-zero acquisition cost
  • Full-stack platform — cloud + on-prem sovereign AI + GPU-as-a-Service (cost intelligence + compliance + fine-tuning)
  • Sovereign AI — only regional platform for Gulf & MENA

docs.title: The Solution
docs.text: AI Gateway delivers one unified API across every major open-source LLM — Llama, Mistral, DeepSeek, Qwen, and beyond. Built-in cost intelligence, enterprise key management, and compliance controls mean platform teams ship faster while keeping security and finance in the loop. Backed by IHC Group ($238B) with sovereign AI positioning for MENA, we combine startup speed with enterprise credibility from day one.

docs.title: Why Now?
docs.text: Open-source models have crossed the performance threshold. Enterprises want to adopt them — they just need infrastructure they can trust. AI Gateway is that infrastructure.

docs.title: Competitive Landscape
docs.text: The open-source inference market is rapidly consolidating around a handful of well-funded players. Yet no single competitor owns the full enterprise platform layer — the combination of inference, FinOps, governance, and sovereign deployment that large organisations actually need. That gap is AI Gateway's opportunity.

docs.text:
THREAT: HIGH

  • Funding: $533M raised
  • Revenue: ~$300M ARR
  • Strength: Research-grade models (own LLM development), training + inference
  • Weakness: Training-heavy focus, less enterprise platform polish

docs.title: Fireworks AI
docs.text:
THREAT: VERY HIGH

  • Funding: $327M raised, $4B valuation
  • Revenue: ~$130M ARR

  • Weakness: Inference-only, no compliance/governance layer

docs.text:

  • Status: Nvidia acquisition ~$6.5B
  • Strength: Custom LPU silicon, extreme speed (>500 tok/s)

docs.title: Platform-First DNA
docs.text:
AI Gateway is architected platform-first — cost intelligence, key management, compliance, and fine-tuning are foundational layers, not add-ons.

This is the same architectural advantage that made Stripe unbeatable in payments. Competitors like Amazon Pay tried to retrofit Stripe's developer experience onto existing infrastructure — and failed. The DX was too deeply embedded in the architecture to copy.

The same dynamic applies here. Competitors would need to:

  • Rebuild their auth/authz layers to support enterprise key management
  • Retrofit cost tracking into every API call path
  • Re-architect for compliance that currently doesn't exist
  • Build fine-tuning lifecycle tooling from scratch

This advantage is structural and compounding. Every feature AI Gateway ships reinforces the platform — every feature a competitor adds is bolted on. The gap widens with time, not narrows.

docs.text:

  • Cost analytics entrenchment — Historical spend data, model-level cost breakdowns, budget alerts. Information lock-in — this data does not exist elsewhere.
  • Prompt libraries — Customer IP stored on-platform: versioned prompts, evaluation datasets, A/B test results.
  • Compliance integration — Audit trails, data residency configs, policy enforcement. Once compliance workflows depend on AI Gateway, ripping them out is a non-starter.

docs.text:
Goal: Land and expand six- and seven-figure enterprise contracts with deep technical lock-in.

  • Multi-year contracts — 1-3 year terms with committed spend minimums and volume discounts.
  • VPC peering — Dedicated infrastructure for the deepest technical lock-in. Customer data never leaves their cloud.
  • SOC 2 certification — Binary gate for enterprise procurement. No SOC 2 = no deal. Target completion by Month 12.
  • Cloud marketplace enterprise listings — Private offers, custom pricing, EDP/MACC burn-down for AWS and Azure customers.

docs.title: The Foundation No Competitor Can Replicate
docs.text:
With IHC Group's backing, Infinia's technology vision, and Tenstorrent's hardware partnership, AI Gateway has a structural foundation that no competitor can replicate.

The backing is not just capital. It is customers (422 subsidiaries), hardware (Tenstorrent RISC-V), regulatory positioning (sovereign AI mandate), and strategic patience ($20.4B cash, no VC clock). Every axis of competition is covered. Every structural advantage compounds over time.

This is not a startup hoping to find product-market fit. This is an enterprise AI platform with product-market fit built into its ownership structure.
